{{Quote|We couldn't catch it, but we could follow its hyperspace wake. We followed its trail as far as we could, heading away from the galactic core.|Canderous Ordo|<ref name="SW:KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hyperspace wake''' was a term used to describe the trail in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. 

==History==
In the year [[3963 BBY]], a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] under the command of [[Canderous Ordo]] encountered what would later come to be known as a [[Yorik-stronha]], disguised as an asteroid in the [[Crispin system/Legends|Crispin system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. After a brief battle, they were able to track the object into the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|edge of the galaxy]], and when they reached the hyperspace wake, the Neo-Crusaders were forced to turn back at the Galactic Rim, apparently thinking that the mysterious object was going on a suicide run into the [[Intergalactic Void|great void]] [[Extragalactic/Legends|outside]] the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="SW:KotOR" />
